description: Fork of exp112 trading nap (14 -> 12, table_dim 16384 -> 4096, 4x smaller per-table) for 4x more tph (qk/v 64 -> 256, out 384 -> 1536). Per-layer LUT weights unchanged (qk/v: 6*256*4096*1=6.29M, out: 1*1536*4096*1=6.29M = 18.88M per layer same as exp112). Per-output entry budget per head also unchanged (256*4096/64 = 16384 = 64*16384/64). What changes: tables/output now 4 (not 1), input pair coverage qk/v 4.2% (vs 1.2%), out_proj 25% (vs 7.3%). Other settings (E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip, balanced) match exp112.
